Next, wrong content accepted by the quality gate accounts for eighteen trials, tracked by OMN-19199. Wrong task class selection from pasted words involves eight trials, identified as OMN-19523. Three classes share four trials each: valid answers refused by shape floors (OMN-19524 and OMN-19005), inability to execute test suites (OMN-19458), and mostly false code review findings (OMN-19457). Two classes have three trials: no terminal before time budget (OMN-19441) and unmet repository lint or type gates (OMN-19527). Finally, bare one-word answers being blanked represents two trials, associated with OMN-19525. This distribution highlights the primary failure modes across the system.
